tasks.title: The store persists private incident state and publishes drafts atomically
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, storage and store bullets; R1, R2, R3 store operations and state table, R4 transactional audit and post-commit callbacks, R5; decisions 3-8 and 10-11. Pin the merged contract 1.8.0 SHA. Add only migration 6; implement private list/detail, draft creation/edit/replacement/discard, publish and notes in the store, public SQL filtering before the resolved limit and publication-time projection, legacy write compatibility and privacy-key rejection, component-removal rules, retention/cascades, limits and resolving-write draft cleanup. All writes re-read and audit within BEGIN IMMEDIATE; callbacks follow commit. Adapt emptyManualIncidents in server.ts to the enlarged interface so the existing server remains type-correct; HTTP routes belong to T2. Cover store and migration counterexamples, including audit rollback, unchanged public update indexes, 50 private resolved rows not consuming the public limit, publication at t2, clock 1000 to 900, and step-5 open/resolved fixtures retaining their public JSON.

tasks.title: Authenticated routes manage drafts and notes while public responses stay private
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, HTTP dispatch, incident-read, wiring, documentation and all Checks/Completion evidence; R2-R4; API items of Counterexamples, Validation and limits, Metrics, Security impact, Performance impact and Rollout order. Dispatch the new handler before /admin/ delegation and add the six bounded route labels; keep all legacy response shapes. Implement every R3 route and its exact body/existence/state ordering, ignored-body size checks, Allow/WWW-Authenticate/throttle responses, private read authentication and safe write logs. Exercise all seven API acceptance scenarios through HTTP with private positive controls, reopening a file database for persistence, audit rollback, metrics and component removal. Document examples, immutable published visibility, concurrent-save limitation and backup-required downgrade. Finish with repository checks, live curl evidence, failing-on-main evidence and performance/security evidence; deploy owns the subsequent compose-e2e run.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; create draft 201 and private detail 200 precede public absence assertions; draft/internal public detail is 404 with {"error":"manual incident not found"}; first publish 200, second 409, public createdAt equals publication time and update 0 at. A resolving draft leaves public fields unchanged until publish, then gives 2 updates and exactly 1 resolved counter increment. Notes survive reopen, remain absent from public bytes and leave updates deep-equal. All R3 state-table and Validation and limits responses match their literal codes/texts. Focused coverage may fail the global threshold.
